items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: A lot of the guys like McGarrity and Urbie Green and all the wonderful players were part of the orchestra.

ctx.x: And you’d get a phone call?

Oh famous places, yeah. Well Jim & Andy’s was one of the later more popular ones. Because he would just see you. And Hurley’s. Hurley’s still exists at the corner of 50th and Sixth Avenue. It’s a little corner shaped building and the Hurley family owned it, an Irish family. And when they built the RCA building there, they wouldn’t sell. And if you ever go by the building you’ll notice that that corner building is a two-story brownstone that’s right into the RCA building still, all these years. And the family just…
So if some producer in the studio had a need all of a sudden for a bass trombone player, could they just call this place?
